sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Raghav Dwivedi
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus directing respondents no.2 and
3 to determine compensation of plot Nos.303, 304, 305 and 306 and pay it to the petitioners and
other co-sharers according to their shares as per amended map.
2.  The case of the petitioners is that, initially, NHAI notified plot Nos.305 and 306 belonging to the parties for acquisition.
The compensation amount was to be released in favour of petitioners no.3 to 6 whose names were recorded over plot nos.305 and 306.

The matter relating to allotment of chak Vishwanath And 5 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 10 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/73122725/
1 was subjudice at that stage in a writ petition bearing No.5582 of 2005 before this Court.

entities.text: allotment of chak Vishwanath And 5 Others vs State Of Up And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioners placed before the authorities the order of status quo dated 07.02.2006 passed by this Court in the writ petition and, as a consequence whereof, the compensation amount was not paid to anyone.
Thereafter, the writ petition was decided in terms of a compromise between the parties.
The order of the writ court is Annexure 5 and according to the compromise between the parties, there has been substantial change in the chaks of the parties.

It is submitted that as per the compromise between the parties, the road would now pass through all four plots and not merely plot Nos.305 and 306 as in the past, therefore, all the petitioners are entitled to compensation according to their respective shares.
3.

Sri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel, has placed on record the instructions received by him, according to which, plot Nos.303 and 304 have not yet been acquired nor there is any award in respect of the aforesaid plots.
4. Sri Raghav Dwivedi, learned counsel appearing for NHAI, is in receipt of instructions from the Project Director.
He submits that NHAI has already taken notice of the change in chaks of the parties.
It has proposed issuance of a fresh notification whereby the area of road falling on plot Nos.303 and 304 as per amended map has also been included.

A draft of said notification has also been placed before this Court for perusal along with covering letter dated 09.04.2024 by which the Project Director has requested Competent Authority to take appropriate steps for issuing notification under Section 3-A of National Highways Act, 1956 covering plot nos.303 and 304.
5.
Sri Raghav Dwivedi submits that as soon as the notification is issued, the petitioners would also be paid compensation for part of the land of plot nos.303 and 304 covered by the road.

6. In view of the aforesaid stand of NHAI, we are of the opinion that no further direction is required to be issued in the instant case, except for the observation that NHAI shall conclude the proceedings and pay compensation to the petitioners as per the amended map expeditiously.
7. The petition stands disposed of accordingly.

Date :- 10.5.2024 AKShukla/-
(Kshitij Shailendra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.)
